name: laravel-filament-agents
description: UI/UX rules for Laravel Filament admin panels (v3, v4, v5) in the wame-filament-ui skill: what a screen shows, in what order and how it looks — panel theme, navigation, resource pages, forms and schemas, tables, actions and modals, notifications, widgets and custom pages — with the per-major differences read from composer.lock. Adds the Filament specifics to the general method in design-agents:wame-ui-ux. The Filament developer agent and a code-patterns skill come later.
